findings.title: All 12 observed opcodes and the version 2.0 loader are at the claimed source locations
findings.detail: ir.rs Instruction schema and IrSource::load accept only SerdeVersion major 2 minor 0. Observed opcodes add, assert, cond_select, constrain_bits, constrain_to_boolean, declare_pub_input, less_than, load_imm, mul, neg, pi_skip, test_eq have definition and ir_vm.rs preprocess plus circuit match lines as recorded in semantic-source-navigation.json. The Instruction enum also defines additional unused-in-snapshots opcodes. Observed subset is not a complete ISA contract.

findings.title: Schema, preprocess, constraint construction, mock/cost-model, and proving are distinct
findings.detail: ir.rs defines JSON instruction fields and the loader. ir_vm.rs::preprocess is a non-ZK run that checks input count, index bounds, boolean 0/1, bit bounds, transcript consumption, and optional communications commitment. Relation::circuit constructs constraints. main.rs MockCompile loads IR and calls IrSource::model -> midnight_zk_stdlib::cost_model only. IrSource::prove calls preprocess then midnight_zk_stdlib::prove. This review did not execute proving, key generation, or mock-compile.

findings.title: Field arithmetic, public-input skip, and communications boundaries are located, not accepted as a contract
findings.detail: Add/Mul/Neg are prime-field Fr operations. Integer financial arithmetic needs a separate range/refinement argument. Preprocess idx_bool rejects non-0/1; circuit Assert uses assert_non_zero and CondSelect uses is_zero with inverted select. PiSkip updates pi_skips and transcript grouping in preprocess and is a no-op in circuit(). Communications commitment, when enabled, prepends the commitment as the second public input and binds inputs plus Output values; preprocess uses transient_commit, circuit uses poseidon(rand||inputs||outputs). Preprocessed is documented as not public API. Dependencies midnight-zk-stdlib 1.0.0, midnight-proofs 0.7.0, midnight-circuits 6.0.0, midnight-transient-crypto 2.0.0, midnight-base-crypto 1.0.0 are Cargo.lock pins; their source is not captured.

findings.title: compactc-v0.31.1 tree is complete and does not supply compiler build sources
findings.detail: tag-ref commit 30034b5e58983bace24c0a22a969946957a73967. source-tree.json truncated false, 24 entries: GitHub templates, docs, LICENSE, renovate, and prerelease 0.27 zips. No compiler or ZKIR build sources. Artifact identity is not source-to-binary equivalence. Root discloses that unverified build assumption. This review does not invent a mandatory reproducible-build gate. Source version match alone is insufficient to claim compiler correctness.

findings.title: Newly acquired source changes the historical interface gap without rewriting 32.1-32.4
findings.detail: Accepted tasks 32.1-32.4 remain historical readiness records. 32.3 remains the blocked_unavailable record that no verified ZKIR interface/semantic contract was bound. This preparation supplies published crate source and release identity that a later reviewed interface design can use. It does not accept opcode semantics, public-input/witness layout, Compact-to-ZKIR correspondence, adapter 32.7/32.9, P20-dependent PCT, or full P31. Sealed mock/materialization evidence is not constraint soundness, ledger settlement, or correspondence.
